gappers.catalyst: Giving back part of this week's AI-momentum rally (OpenAI Astra tie-in, Hudson River Trading compute deal) amid renewed scrutiny of CoreWeave's leveraged balance sheet.
gappers.catalyst_detail: CRWV rallied roughly 12-16% over Sept 8-9 2026 on a new AI-compute deal with Hudson River Trading and enthusiasm tied to OpenAI's Astra model, touching near $100. Q2 2026 earnings (reported Aug 11-12) showed revenue up 24% sequentially to $2.6B and gross margin above 60%, but coverage (Seeking Alpha) has flagged the company's escalating debt load, now at $27.5B, funding its datacenter buildout. Today's session gave back part of the spike, closing/trading around $89.83 vs $94.975 prior close.
gappers.why: Momentum buyers who piled in on the OpenAI Astra/Hudson River Trading news are taking profits as the rally stalls; the leveraged-balance-sheet bear case and a broader volatile-rate environment (pressuring long-duration, capex-heavy growth names) are providing the catalyst for the giveback.
gappers.impact: Reads as mean-reversion after an outsized 2-day AI-momentum spike (~+12-16%) rather than a new negative catalyst. Volume (267,995) is elevated but not extreme for a name this actively traded. No other AI-infrastructure names on today's list to confirm sector-wide read-through; watch peers (NBIS, datacenter-linked names) to see if the pullback is CRWV-specific profit-taking or a broader AI-infra rotation.
gappers.horizon: SHORT_TERM - this is a giveback of a headline-driven spike (OpenAI Astra / Hudson River Trading news), not a new structural catalyst; expect continued chop/fade over the next few sessions rather than a durable new trend.
gappers.opportunity_cost: Only gapper to clear today's filters, so no ranked competition from this scan. 0/6 open positions, weekly trade count is the binding cap, not the position-count cap. The $27.5B debt overhang (Seeking Alpha bear case) keeps the R:R marginal for a swing hold; entry here would need a stop below the recent multi-day range to respect the 'never within 3% of current price' rule, and 2:1 R:R at that stop distance is unconfirmed. Research only, no size recommended.
